# Przemysław Wiktor Pardel

> Przemysław Wiktor Pardel (also Przemek Pardel), PhD Eng., is a Polish research scientist and engineer working on medical image analysis, computer vision and interpretable machine learning. He is an Assistant Professor at the Institute of Computer Science, University of Rzeszów, and at the Department of Computer Science, Faculty of Engineering Sciences, Academy of Applied Sciences in Nowy Sącz (ANS), and a researcher at the University of Zurich.

## Research

- Transparent, quantitatively validated AI systems for medical decision support, with emphasis on reproducibility, annotation reliability and geometry-aware modelling.
- Since October 2025: research collaboration with the University of Zurich and the University Animal Hospital Zurich (Kleintierkliniken, Universitäres Tierspital Zürich) on artificial intelligence and deep learning in veterinary diagnostic imaging and orthopaedic surgery, including automated tibial plateau angle measurement.
- Earlier work: rough sets for classification of cardiological data, augmented reality (light-source extraction, image-based lighting), scalable semantic document processing.
- Sports analytics: video and timing data for athletic and combat-sport technique.

## Career

- University of Rzeszów: Assistant and Researcher, then Assistant Professor, 2008–2016; currently Assistant Professor.
- Academy of Applied Sciences in Nowy Sącz: Assistant Professor since October 2026.
- University of Zurich: researcher since October 2025.
- Google, 2016–2025: global developer programmes (Google Developer Experts, Cloud Champions, Accelerator mentors), AI and Gemini; co-organiser of the SciFoo conference; work with Google X; lead of a European technology start-up accelerator.
- University of Warsaw, 2010–2014: Research Assistant, Senior Research Developer (SYNAT project, NCBR SP/I/1/77065/10).
- Founder and lead developer of Photometer PRO (since 2016), a light-metering application for professionals and scientists.
- Education: PhD Eng. in Computer Science; MBA; Singularity University alumnus.

## Projects, honours, memberships

- Commander and Habitat Systems Officer, SESU 48 international analog lunar mission, Analog Astronaut Training Center (2022).
- National Science Centre grant DEC-2013/09/B/ST6/01568, Interdisciplinary Centre for Computational Modelling, University of Rzeszów (2013–2016).
- Mentioned in the Nobel Peace Prize letter of thanks by the United Nations World Food Programme Innovation Accelerator (2020).
- Sumobot Champion, 1st place, Singularity University (2017).
- Member of the Association for Image Processing (IAPR member society), Mensa International and Intertel International.
- Obtained the maximum score on the Mensa admission test, placing him within the top 1% of the population on standardised intelligence measures; member of Intertel International (99th percentile threshold).
